name: Current regime
derivation: The variant reads volatility only, so a present breadth value must not change its answer and a missing one must not prevent it. Train volatility 0.01 through 0.06 in steps of 0.01, six values: index round(0.3333 * 5) = round(1.667) = 2 gives 0.03; index round(0.6667 * 5) = round(3.33) = 3 gives 0.04. The last two queries are the same volatility with and without a breadth reading and must agree.
note: expected is the fitted cuts first (breadth then volatility), then one label per query
